evidence.quote: I should have posted blinds at the start, so this hand had nothing at stake.
Chip delta is -10, and your bankroll is 990.

criteria.why: Mostly plain dealer voice with no JSON or ids. One slip: the turn 4 reply talks about its own mistake ('I should have posted blinds'), which is meta commentary.

evidence.quote: The pot is empty, so betting the pot isn't possible yet. Your options are check or fold.
You raise the pot, putting in 50 more to make it 60 total.

criteria.why: Most moves are answered, and the impossible bet is explained with alternatives. But in turn 8 'Bet the pot' was used as a pre-flop raise with an odd amount, and the dealer's call was auto-played.

evidence.quote: You raise the pot, putting in 50 more to make it 60 total.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals, plays the dealer and settles hands itself. The turn 7 deal-again silently posted a 10 blind with the same hand and the same dealer cards. The bankroll went 990 to 980 with no mention of the prior hand, and the exact bet size is dubious.

evidence.quote: The pot is 30. Call 10, raise, or fold.
You raise the pot, putting in 50 more to make it 60 total. The dealer calls, the pot is 120
Chip delta is -10, and your bankroll is 990.

criteria.why: Turn 8 math is inconsistent: 60 each makes 120, but the bankroll fell by 50 to 930 (from 980) when the player put in 60 total, a 10 blind plus 50, which matches. Meanwhile turn 6 shows the pot at 30 with the player losing 10, and turn 7 starts at 980 although the reply never explains the second blind. Also, turn 2 said the pot is empty although turn 4 later calls it 0 consistently, but the surface said 'check or fold' while the reply earlier offered bet, a mild contradiction.
